name: Inverse Rendering with Shadow Rays
aliases: Radiance field with explicit direct illumination
definition: A rendering and optimization technique that augments the global illumination radiance field with explicit direct illumination terms from known point light sources, computed via shadow rays to improve mesh reconstruction and novel view synthesis accuracy.
summary: Inverse Rendering with Shadow Rays augments radiance fields with explicit direct illumination from known lights to enable physically accurate shadow casting, unlike methods that rely on rasterization.
